agent_priors_used: General prior (agent knowledge, NOT SPIDER evidence): task banks in which the correct action is fully determined by the task specification produce near-ceiling correctness for cold baselines, so benchmark dynamic range requires tasks whose correct route depends on discovery (session state, resource identity, schema) not contained in the prompt. SPIDER evidence independently confirmed ceiling degeneracy on one deterministic REST family; using that lesson as a general design rule for all future task banks is the prior, not the evidence.

General prior (agent knowledge, NOT SPIDER evidence): repeated identical non-retryable pre-freeze failure fingerprints shared across several lanes signal an infrastructure/provider-chain block that should be repaired once in the control plane, and must not be mistaken for a scientific negative or used to redirect lanes.

General prior (agent knowledge, NOT SPIDER evidence): a one-shot constructibility certificate with a predeclared fail-loudly branch is a cheap decisive instrument - it either establishes a measurement route or closes it with a stated reason - whereas incrementally re-reading the same structurally degenerate population is not; this favors letting the pending certificate designs reach their frozen decision.

General prior (agent knowledge, NOT SPIDER evidence): end-to-end economics of a capability cannot be measured before that capability exists on the shipped path; integration of an already-audited mechanism dominates further offline refinement of the same mechanism (threat-of-the-bleeding-edge for offline-only prototypes).
